classification.difficultyReason: Choose two inverse operations in reverse order and simplify between them. Supplied intermediate rows scaffold the sequence, including equations with the unknown on the right and a negative result.

content.prompt: Solve these equations, showing clearly the inverse operations.

answer.worked:
Subtract $7$ from both sides, then divide both sides by $2$.
$$\begin{align*}2x&=8\\x&=4\end{align*}$$

Add $6$ to both sides, then divide both sides by $2$.
$$\begin{align*}2x&=10\\x&=5\end{align*}$$

Subtract $1$ from both sides, then multiply both sides by $3$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{3}&=9\\x&=27\end{align*}$$

Subtract $2$ from both sides, then divide both sides by $4$.
$$\begin{align*}4x&=8\\x&=2\end{align*}$$

Subtract $5$ from both sides, then divide both sides by $3$.
$$\begin{align*}9&=3x\\x&=3\end{align*}$$

Add $1$ to both sides, then divide both sides by $2$.
$$\begin{align*}2x&=5\\x&=\frac{5}{2}=2.5\end{align*}$$

Subtract $1$ from both sides, then multiply both sides by $2$.
$$\begin{align*}7&=\frac{x}{2}\\x&=14\end{align*}$$

Add $2$ to both sides, then multiply both sides by $3$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{3}&=-2\\x&=-6\end{align*}$$
